Use PaneGroup for the orientation, Pane for each region, and Handle between panes. Use native Svelte for storage with methods and callbacks with multiple arguments.

## Usage

```ts
import { resizable, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/resizable';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/resizable`. It [registers](../../registration/) 3 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

### `shadcn.Resizable.Handle`

Native exports include `components.Handle`, `components.ResizableHandle`.

| `withHandle` | `boolean` | Default `false` |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Handle>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
